public.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
public.description: Return the longest contiguous substring that can be made entirely one repeated letter by replacing at most k characters. text has 0 to 1000 uppercase ASCII letters; k is 0 through text length.
hints: A window needs its length minus its most frequent count replacements.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A sliding window keeps a nondecreasing maximum frequency and shrinks when the replacement bound is exceeded. Stale maxima preserve the best achievable length. O(n) time.
